a.d: Completes an action and leaves it in plain sight or accessible for immediate use.
ex: 손님맞이를 위해 식탁 위에 과일을 깨끗이 **씻어 놓았어요**. / For welcoming guests, I washed fruits and laid them out on the table.

b.d: Safeguards an item, data, or resource in a secure place for unexpected future needs.
ex: 만약의 사태에 대비해 중요한 서류를 금고에 안전하게 **보관해 두었습니다**. / In preparation for emergencies, I safely stored important papers in the safe.

im-c65-01.tip: Think of 놓다 as "placing out ready to be used" (열어 놓다, 켜 놓다, 써 놓다) and 두다 as "tucking away for future security" (저장해 두다, 적어 두다, 아껴 두다).

im-c65-02.tip: -(으)ㄴ 채로 highlights continuing with shoes on (신은 채로), clothes on (입은 채로), or lights on (켠 채로) where they would normally be removed or altered.
